proposals.title: Revisión metodológica y procedencia
proposals.objective: Exact historical input lineage and explicit pairs, weights, reuse, overlap, tie-preserving bins and support diagnostics. Preserve original evidence.

proposals.title: Control realmente apareado y benchmark de su propio censo
proposals.objective: Zone-free consolidation controls with equivalent geometry and pre-anchor activity, plus controls versus own census. Freeze support/calipers/scales before outcomes.

proposals.title: Separar compresión en barras de tiempo de reloj
proposals.objective: Retain historical O5 and preregister wall-clock endpoints, bounded temporal response and censoring to separate range from trading speed.

proposals.title: Un único uso económico congelado, si sobrevive
proposals.objective: One existing frozen rule with/without context net of costs, without simultaneously changing entry/stop/target. Compression is not reversal/profit/lower tail risk.

replication_gate.requirement: Certified new data, exposure declared, independent replication design; MNQ/NQ share underlying and are not independent markets.
